# Step 2.225: no person's id in any public answer

Before this step, the snapshot `GET …/games/{game}/snapshot` (`players[].playerId`, the person's id), and so the
public game page's flight data (`LiveGameView`'s `initial`), and box rows (`id: p.personId`).

- Scorer-only and not changed: rosters, state, commands, session, copy, format, reopen,
  not-started, scoring, staff-numbers, my-team, `/score/...`, every admin page.

## Layer 1 and 2 (done)

- Key: `apps/web/src/server/player-key.ts` (HMAC-SHA-256 of label, game id, player id, 16 bytes,
  a version 8 UUID; T-462/T-463), core's `readGameSnapshot` fifth argument. Not base64url: an
  open page reads `playerId` as a UUID. Secret (T-465): `SESSION_SECRET`, else HKDF of
  `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, else random on made-up data; set again at each start (`container.ts`).
- Scan (T-466, T-467): `tests/browser/public-pages-on-database-test.mjs` part 4, database and
  stand-in. `live-game-test`: a page given other keys takes the next answer whole.

## Fix round (review M1, L1 to L4)

- M1: every followed page must answer 200 after its redirects (only `/{league}/no-such-page`
  may end 404); each game's page and snapshot 200; pages read are counted; stopping at the
  400-page limit fails. Seen: `GamePage` made to throw, the scan failed in all three played
  leagues; put back, 219 checks pass.
- L1: account ids from `/admin/games/scorekeepers` (option and `account` values); players counted
  per league (Harbor City's games are unplayed: it must list none); on the stand-in a player is
  added by number only (`add-player`, protocol 2) and scored, so one line has no name. No screen
  shows an owner a profile id and no public code reads one: not collected (T-467).
- L3: `readGamePage` takes the key as an optional fourth argument; the box orders equal or no
  numbers by name shown (none last), then key. Unit test in `read-game-page.test.ts` (failed with
  the person-id order put back). The game page and `staff-numbers-endpoint.ts` pass the key.
- L4: T-462's row names T-465's order. L2 (within the promise): a copy of THIS game kept before a
  player is hidden still names their line by key; their jersey and points name it anyway.
- For the polish list: making `SESSION_SECRET` required later changes every key once; an HKDF
  step from it (as for the service key) would be cleaner than sharing it raw with sessions.
